critical_safety_rules: ADDRESS, CART, SAFETY, and AUTH categories immediately set SafeToStop=True and call Stop flow
Transient errors flag ShouldRetry=True within max_retries limit
Launches Blinkit in Google Chrome with PA extension enabled
Address verification gate stops execution immediately if displayed address mismatches config
Per-item search (/s/?q=) and deterministic addition to cart
Verification of cart totals against budget limit
Absolute stop before payment: no place order or checkout clicks
When TestMode=true, drafts notification and logs SKIPPED without sending real emails
Live mode uses authorized connection only, never storing passwords in flow
When TestMode=true, records SKIPPED without sending external messages
When WhatsApp Business is unconfigured, logs UNSUPPORTED with fallback note
Tokens loaded from environment variable WHATSAPP_TOKEN, never committed
Pre-flight config validation via npm run validate-config before any browser launch
Orchestrates subflows in sequence: ShoppingProcess -> gen-summary -> Email -> WhatsApp
Outputs execution_report.txt and audit logs to outputs/
